browser.automated_evidence: Playwright Chromium headless shell, one worker, traces retained only on failure; no video or screenshots by default.
browser.manual_evidence: A normal host browser supplies keyboard, 200% zoom/reflow, JavaScript-disabled, and accessibility checks; on WSL2 this is the Windows browser through localhost.

evidence_boundary: The deterministic Python model validates contracts. Headless automated evidence and host-browser manual evidence are distinct. The pinned Chromium harness validates this lab on its recorded host; neither establishes universal browser or production-CDN behavior.
